# Christina Antonelli

> > Technology journalism covering artificial intelligence, healthcare innovation, cybersecurity, and enterprise software development.

Christina Antonelli's professional blog features in-depth analysis of AI developments (OpenAI, ChatGPT), healthcare technology innovations, cybersecurity trends, and business technology. Content spans enterprise software, healthtech startups, machine learning applications, and critical infrastructure security.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- OpenAI & ChatGPT
- Healthcare Technology & EHR Systems
- Cybersecurity & Information Security
- NXTUS Healthtech Competition
- Kansas City Startup Ecosystem
- Enterprise Software Development
- AI Agents & Automation
- CrowdStrike Incident Analysis
- Rural Health & Community Health
- Identity Management
- FedRAMP Compliance
- Data Breach Prevention
- Senior Living Innovation
- Business Spend Management
